ORIGIN.quote: eventually removes thousands of pages with names characteristic of scratch work: `Agent...`, `OpenAI...`, `Test...`, `LoopNextWord...`, and research bridges
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away with no sense that the swarm might be an OpenAI deployment — the single appearance of "OpenAI" is an incidental page-name prefix in a list illustrating deletion patterns, and the dedicated attribution section (§6) canvasses "human research teams, many independent automated agents, or a single actor simulating many agents" without ever naming an operator. It scores above 0.0 because the report itself (not quoted agent text) does surface OpenAI-bearing evidence, and below 0.4 because the possibility is never framed as bearing on provenance, let alone raised and then set aside.
